layers.message: Set up records workspace with Postgres client, listing, and CSV export
Document local database setup for integration tests
Record project context for streaming export
Design streaming export with export jobs
Stream CSV exports through a cursor inside an export job transaction

graderOnly: pnpm --filter export test:integration exits 1 in this environment because no PostgreSQL server is reachable at 127.0.0.1:5432 (connect ECONNREFUSED in every integration test); this is an environment limitation, not an implementation defect.

AC-001 requires real streaming through a server-side cursor and a real transaction rollback that leaves no export_jobs row; the mocked unit tests in packages/export/test/unit/export.test.js only show the SQL statement sequence and the file cleanup against a fake client and cannot establish either.
No implementation defect is known: by inspection the streaming export and its rollback path follow the design, and the unit and client protocol tests pass.

Producing the missing evidence needs the user to start the local database (docker compose up -d db, per README.md) or provide a reachable DATABASE_URL; Docker and PostgreSQL are not available to the role.
No integration test exercises a failed export (rollback) against a real database; only the happy-path export and listRecords are covered there.

all.why: an unavailable database is not routed as an implementation failure
no failure frame is pushed for an environment limitation
the Tester records its assessment and the attempted command in the cycle report
passing mocked unit tests cannot complete verification of AC-001
producing the integration evidence needs the user to make a database reachable

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Tester does not change implementation, the schema, or the database setup

selfChecks.why: unit checks pass offline without a database
the unit suite runs 13 tests: csv 4, records 5, export 4 (mocked client)
the client protocol tests pass against the in-process stand-in server
the integration command exits 1 because the local database is unavailable
all three integration tests fail on the connection, none on an assertion
no integration test exercises a failed export
the TESTING state and records are valid
stated workflow state: TESTING, STANDARD, FORWARD from DEVELOPING, nothing blocked, recovery inactive

selfChecks.cmd: test ! -e .standards/docs/verification && test -f .standards/CONTEXT.md && grep -q 'Status`: `COMPLETE`$' .standards/docs/development/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && ! git status --porcelain | grep -q .
selfChecks.why: no verification report yet, context exists, plan complete, clean tree
the npm registry is unreachable, so no database server can be installed during the run

notes: Standalone fixture (base null): export-testing uses an in-memory store and a quoting-only AC-001, which cannot express a database that is unavailable or streaming and rollback. Pre-install 00-project commits a pnpm workspace: root records-platform, packages/db (@records/db, an in-repo PostgreSQL client over node:net with trust/cleartext/md5 auth and the simple query protocol, plus tests against an in-process stand-in server), and packages/export (package name export: config, csv, records listing, a load-everything exportRecords, unit tests with fake clients, integration tests that connect to DATABASE_URL defaulting to 127.0.0.1:5432); pnpmInstall commits the lockfile. 05-docs adds docker-compose.yml (postgres:16, trust) and README integration instructions. 50-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md, STATE SCOPING. 55-scope: AC-001 (batched streaming in id order, export job recorded, full rollback and no file on failure) and AC-002 (CSV format unchanged), STATE ARCHITECTING. 60-design: cursor in one transaction, export_jobs table, failure path, STATE DEVELOPING. 65-plan: APPROVED plan, three PENDING steps. 70-implement: export_jobs in schema, cursor-based exportRecords with rollback, 4 mocked unit tests, helper drops export_jobs, one happy-path integration test. 75-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-checks citing the implementation commit (integration run claimed passing on the Developer's machine with docker compose), STATE TESTING FORWARD from DEVELOPING. No verification report. In the runner nothing listens on 5432, so test:integration fails with ECONNREFUSED in all 3 tests; unit (13) and client (3) tests pass.

decision.note: Owner-approved fix: the generated export.js catch block let a cleanup rm (e.g. ENOTDIR) throw before ROLLBACK, an unplanted defect the role found. Cleanup rm calls now ignore their own errors, so ROLLBACK always runs and the original error is rethrown; documented order (remove files, then ROLLBACK) kept.
